wavesAudited.name: Prime Agent System (PAS - 2026-09-01 Scope)
wavesAudited.summary: Audited the complete 810-line PAS codebase at commit 947e71cd5dbaaf9c5b3840dd1b23e8e99d9a564d and post-commit L2PASDeployer additions. Verified cbeam pacing, rbeam step/expiry enforcement, unlimited-rate-limit protection in Configurator, and doubly-linked list queue/cancel/execute invariants in Timelock. Live Mainnet PAS_TIMELOCK (0xb50a06af02dde44db6ea7ee729403848c2b35293) is currently paused (paused=1) with a 14-day (1,209,600s) delay.

wavesAudited.name: Diamond PAU Architecture & All 25 Mainnet Facets (2026-07-06 Scope)
wavesAudited.summary: Audited core Diamond PAU dispatch/storage isolation (ERC-7201 namespaces), RateLimits linear replenishment and key derivation, and all 25 deployed facets on PAU_BEACON (0x829dc2b7e94b1954f0764e573f2e0d45afa28199), plus post-v1140 commits (AaveV4Facet, SwapAssetFacet, L2BeaconSpell). Verified balance-delta accounting, residual approval clearing via ApproveLib, and ERC-4626 donation attack protection via maxExchangeRate.

wavesAudited.name: Surplus Buffer Engine Beam & Emergency Spells (2026-07-21 & 2026-08-17 Scope)
wavesAudited.summary: Audited SBEBeam.sol and FarmOwner.sol (beam branch), Kicker/Splitter surplus distribution and reward duration re-rating, StarGuard spell codehash/deadline/ownership preservation, and stUSDS emergency spells.

wavesAudited.name: StUSDS ($181.95M TVL), Lockstake, Cross-Chain OApp/OFT (EVM + Solana), & Core Modules
wavesAudited.summary: Audited StUsds ERC-4626/chi/cut/line accounting ($181.95M live TVL), LockstakeEngine & LockstakeClipper bad-debt Due/cut integration, LayerZero EVM + Solana Anchor OFT and Governance relay programs, and AllocatorVault/Buffer.

architecturalNotesAndEdgeCases.details: In StUsds.sol, cut(rad) slashes chi = uint192(oldChi * (totalAssets_ - assets) / totalAssets_). If a catastrophic bad-debt event or governance cut ever sets assets == totalAssets_ (or rounds newChi down to 0 while totalSupply > 0), chi becomes 0 permanently: _drip() multiplies by chi_ (0), and deposit() / withdraw() revert with division-by-zero Panic(0x12) while mint() / redeem() revert with StUsds/assets-zero, requiring a UUPS upgrade by governance to recover.

Controller.updateIntegrations(ids) pulls the current Config from Beacon at execution time without taking an expected config hash parameter. As documented in L2BeaconSpell.sol, if a PAS Configurator operator queues/executes a Controller sync, off-chain verification must ensure the Beacon config was not modified in between.

architecturalNotesAndEdgeCases.classification: Post-v1140 Unreleased Facet Additions on dev Branch
architecturalNotesAndEdgeCases.details: On live Mainnet PAU_BEACON (0x829dc2b7e94b1954f0764e573f2e0d45afa28199), exactly 25 facets are registered (matching the 2026-07-06 Immunefi scope list). Newer facets in the dev branch of diamond-pau (AaveV4Facet, NFATHaloFacet, NFATPrimeFacet, PSM3Facet, SwapAssetFacet) are not yet registered on Mainnet PAU_BEACON.
